snippet.title: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Release Date Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10011942
 
ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE™ will be released on October 2nd, 2026!
  
As ACE COMBAT celebrates its 30th anniversary, the long-awaited newest installment soars in, elevating the series to new heights. #ACECOMBAT8 #WingsOfTheve
  
July 2029: The Federation of Central Usea (FCU) has fallen under attack by the Republic of Sotoa. Much of the nation has been invaded, the military is scattered, and you are left adrift at sea aboard the aging aircraft carrier Endurance. On this ship, you are given the call sign “Wings of Theve”—a legendary ace, and a symbol of hope for the capital of Usea.
  
Now, you must carry that name and take to the skies. With new comrades at your side, fight to reclaim your lost homeland.
  
What is ACE COMBAT series?
A flight-shooting game series with over 21 million copies shipped to date. Players take on the role of an ace pilot, where you can enjoy the exhilaration of soaring freely through a realistic, immersive sky, the thrill of shooting down and destroying enemy aircraft one after another based on their own judgment, and rise above challenges.
 
-----------------------------------
『ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE™』
-----------------------------------
Release date：October 2nd, 2026
Genre：Flight shooting
Platform：PlayStation®5
